rows.grounds: object of hearing; refers to the supreme nectar mentioned in context
compound describing the nectar as the true nature of Kaula
imperative command addressed to the listener
compound qualifying the Kaula essence as constituted by kāmakalā

items.question: What essential nature characterizes the nectar identified with the Kaula reality?
premises: The nectar is identified as the true essence of Kaula.
This Kaula essence is constituted by kāmakalā.
The listener is commanded to hear about this nectar.
items.inference: The supreme nectar to be understood is the Kaula essence whose very nature is kāmakalā.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal sense of kāmakalā in this context is not fully specified within the verse alone.
items.plain_english: Hear of the nectar, the true essence of Kaula, which consists of kāmakalā.
